metadata.title: माही किनारे देसी मुर्गा और महुआ की धार | Desi Murga cooked in Mahua Wine | Adivasi Food
metadata.description:
In this special episode of The Tribal Kitchen, we bring you a unique yet simple recipe of Desi Murga (country chicken), straight from the heart of tribal India.
Shot along the serene banks of the Mahi River in Ratlam district, Madhya Pradesh, this episode features the Bhil tribe — one of the oldest indigenous communities of India. Watch as they prepare Desi Murga in their traditional style using locally available ingredients and age-old cooking methods that bring out rich, earthy flavors.
This isn’t just about food — it’s about culture, community, and a way of life that stays rooted in nature.

👉 Don’t forget to like, share, and subscribe for more such soulful stories from Tribal India.
